one-public-readonly-page.evidence: Calls readAppendLogPage once on supplied typed log with {after,limit}; returns its Promise mapping. Public storage imports and consumer signature compile. No extra read loop, writes, storage replacement or replay.

record-and-cursor-preservation.evidence: Maps actual entries key,seq,value.id,value.amount in original order; passes nextAfter and done unchanged. Zero survives direct property copies; no positional sequence or truthiness fallback.

page-boundary-interpretation.evidence: Explains empty page retains cursor-1/done true; seq0/amount0 and nextAfter0 retained; full final page done true due to limit+1 lookahead; done is read-local, future appends remain possible. Matches append-log.ts160-175.
